welcome_lead: Trade degrees for radians and conquer the unit circle's exact values.
meta_desc: Maths adventure on radian measure, arc length, sector area and exact trig values.
final_note: π radians = 180°, your unit-circle north star!

walkthroughs.body_html:
Find arc length for r = 6 cm, θ = π/3.

s = rθ = 6 × π/3 = 2π ≈ 6.28 cm.

options: c^2 represents any side of the triangle as long as the other two are squared.
c^2 represents the side opposite the largest angle that is not 90 degrees.
The hypotenuse — the longest side, opposite the right angle.
